policy: Each fifth-edition domain declares its laboratory family, unit prefix, phase, strand, per-project artifact imports, exported artifact contracts, sealed decisions, manual evidence and gate policy here. The generator consumes these declarations; a domain absent from this file cannot enter the catalog.

phases.title: Advanced systems construction
phases.gate: Kernel, port, lifecycle, compiler, verification, I/O, security and numerical mechanisms with evidence scoped to each environment.

phases.title: Modern abstractions from first principles
phases.gate: Representation, ownership, failure and cost contracts compose across errors, values, generics, layout and dispatch.

phases.title: Modern execution, runtime and data models
phases.gate: Protocols, continuations, concurrency, object runtimes, resilience and replicated state withstand changed conditions.
